purpose: Close the startups offer: state who qualifies (size and investor-backing criteria), show the accepted investors as a logo wall, give one action to apply, and list the terms in small print.

behaviour.note: Centre-aligned block: heading, two bold criteria joined by a circular plus divider, a small note below the second criterion, the investor logo grid, the apply button; then a left-aligned Terms list with disc bullets. Criteria column is capped at 440px.
The investor logo wall is embedded here rather than being its own section (see social-proof.logo-grid, variant investors-small-grid). 21 logos, PNG, 372x282, lazy loaded.
Last section before the footer on /startups; it follows the coloured testimonial band.

criteria.note: Two bold requirement statements separated by a plus divider. Observed 8 and 11 words.

criteriaNote.note: Small print under the second criterion. Observed about 22 words.

investors.note: Accepted investor and accelerator logos. Observed 21.

cta.note: Observed 4-word label to the apply page.

terms.note: Bullet sentences. Observed 3, each up to about 16 words.
